label: Unvalidated context, not used by any model. Registration-based: the party a voter is registered with, not how the ballot was cast.

test.text: This method failed the project's registered test (right on direction 61 %, made estimates worse): the registered early-vote-gap test, 24 races, direction 14/23 = 61 %, RMSE 2.59 -> 3.20 (docs/us_ev_gap.md). That test used a state's own earlier cycles; the offset used here is a simpler cousin and was not itself registered.

method.offset: 2022 certified D two-party share minus the 2022 registered-party D share of D+R among banked ballots at the same stage (same days before Election Day)
method.implied: 2026 registered-party D share of D+R among banked ballots plus that offset
method.agrees: within 2 points of the model's pre-count share
method.partial_day: Banked ballots are counted through the party file's date; county composition is partial-day, mix of methods differs by state, and the banked electorate drifts toward R as Election Day nears
